FIG.7.1 · MEMORY STRUCTURE

六层记忆结构

从单次请求瞬时状态到跨会话长期沉淀，清晰定义生命周期、存储载体与治理边界。

TIERS
6 LAYERS
GOVERNANCE
CQRS ISOLATED
01 EPHEMERAL
① Session Metadata
conversation_id · user_id · tenant_id · locale · current task · permissions
作用域: 单次会话 / 请求 瞬时上下文
02 SHORT-TERM
② Working Memory（任务结束可过期）
current plan · intermediate results · open questions · tool outputs
任务结束可过期 执行中间态
03 USER PROFILE
③ Structured Profile（稳定偏好）
language preference · role · approved tools · report format
稳定偏好 · 显式维护 静态画像
04 EVENT LOG
④ Episodic Memory（发生过什么）
user asked X · system did Y · result was Z · feedback ±
发生过什么 · 交互溯源 情景事件流
05 KNOWLEDGE
⑤ Semantic Memory（稳定事实）
organization / project facts · definitions · policies
稳定事实 · 知识图谱 企业级事实
06 SKILL / PATTERN
⑥ Procedural Memory（可复用流程）
how to perform task X · validated workflow · repair strategy
可复用流程 · 求解范式 程序性技能
💡

架构分层原则：短期记忆（①/②）在内存/Redis 中随会话生命周期快速流动；长期记忆（③/④/⑤/⑥）绝不随模型自由写入，必须经过 Write Pipeline（FIG.7.2） 的结构化抽取、权限校验、去重与版本消解后方可持久化。

LEDGERAppend-only
正常纠正以新事件表达；仍需执行删除、脱敏、保留期限及派生缓存失效策略。
VIEWS当前视图
current user profile / current state，从事件日志派生。
POLICY治理策略
什么能写、能读、会过期、能共享。每条 Memory 记录 Valid Time 与 Transaction Time。
FIG.7.2

Write Pipeline（不让模型自由写）

STEP 1

Conversation / Event

STEP 2

Candidate Extraction → Normalize → Deduplicate

STEP 3

Conflict Check → Permission / Policy Check

STEP 4

Store（source · confidence · owner · scope · validity · sensitivity · version）→ Update Views

FIG.7.3

Read Pipeline（不每次读全部）

STEP 1

Current Query

STEP 2

Query Classification → Access Filter

STEP 3

Retrieve Relevant Memory

STEP 4

Rank by Relevance + Recency + Quality → Assemble Context

多用户与权限隔离

tenant_id · user_id · resource ACL · memory scope。未经授权的 Memory：不应进入检索候选、不应进入模型上下文、不应在拒答中泄漏其存在。

AutodidactAgent 的诚实定位

AutodidactAgent mainly implements episodic and procedural memory through solved cases and reusable skills. It is not a general-purpose user-profile memory system.

它更接近 Solved Case + Best Skill + Score + Provenance，而不是通用长期用户记忆。

Short-term → Long-term Memory Promotion

FIG.7.4

Memory Promotion Pipeline

STEP 1

Working State

STEP 2

Candidate Extraction

STEP 3

Importance + Stability

STEP 4

Dedup + Conflict Check

STEP 5

Long-term Store + Provenance

短期记忆不是自动“变成”长期记忆。只有满足稳定性、复用价值、用户授权和低冲突风险的信息才应 Promotion；临时工具输出、未验证推断和敏感信息默认不晋升。

Context Compression 的触发机制

Token budget approaching threshold
Topic / task phase changes
Stable decision reached
Repeated transcript with low new information
Tool result is large but only a small evidence subset is needed
Long-running session checkpoint

可靠做法不是无限“摘要的摘要”，而是保留事件日志和关键 provenance，从可验证原始记录重新生成 compact view。

必背

I do not treat the transcript as the state. I maintain structured state and compress views while preserving provenance.

2026-09-28 · 验证边界

六层记忆是本手册 taxonomy。身份/权限来源于可信安全上下文；Memory 不授予权限。Append-only 不等于永久保留敏感内容；纠正、删除、保留期限和派生视图失效都需单独设计。

LangGraph memory

版本说明：Letta V1 SDK 使用 memory blocks 和 archival memory；当前 Agent SDK 使用 Git 支持的 MemFS，编辑通过 commit / push 持久化。 Letta Agent SDK memory

Cross-session Memory：跨会话记住的是受治理的状态 §7.X

“预算不能超过 5000”是否应该跨会话记住，先看 scope 与 durability：它可能只是当前任务约束，也可能是项目级硬约束或稳定用户偏好。Memory 的核心不是存储介质，而是 promotion、scope、provenance、conflict 和 retrieval policy。

FIG.7.X1 · CROSS-SESSION MEMORY GOVERNANCE

写入要晋升，读取要路由，冲突要保留 lineage

长历史摘要只是 Context View。真正 durable 的约束应有结构化 scope、provenance、validity 与 supersession。

WRITE 01

Candidate Extraction

从用户显式陈述、Tool observation 或模型推断中提取候选记忆，并先标记 source_kind。
WRITE 02

Scope + Durability Gate

判断 task / thread / project / user / tenant scope，以及 temporary / stable / expiring。只有真正 durable 的信息进入长期存储。
STORE

Durable Memory + Provenance

保存 value 之外，还保存 source、confidence、valid_from / valid_to、supersedes、sensitivity 和 owner。
READ

Memory Route + Filters

当前 Decision 先决定需要哪类 Memory，再做 scope、permission、validity、relevance 过滤；不是对所有历史做一次全局向量搜索。
CONFLICT

Authority + Supersession

explicit correction、scope specificity、source authority、valid time 与 confidence 一起决定当前有效值；newer 不自动等于更 authoritative。
核心原则

Write selectively. Read selectively. Expire explicitly. Correct with lineage.

FIG.7.X2 · SAME SENTENCE, DIFFERENT MEMORY LIFETIME

同一句“预算 ≤5000”，可能属于三种不同生命周期

表达Scope落点何时失效
“这次采购预算 ≤5000”current_taskWorking State任务完成
“Atlas 本季度预算 ≤5000”project:atlasProject-scoped durable constraintvalid_to / 明确修改
“以后旅行单次预算都 ≤5000”userStructured Profile用户更新偏好
LONG CONTEXT ≠ DURABLE MEMORY

Lost in the Middle 说明长上下文存在位置敏感性，但跨会话真正需要的是 persisted state / memory lifecycle。如果信息根本没有被持久化，新 Thread 里就无从召回。

Enterprise Knowledge Context：企业知识是受治理的上下文 §7.K

企业知识基础设施的目标不是把更多文本塞进向量库，而是把组织概念、规则、流程、案例和实时事实变成可版本化、可授权、可追溯的 Agent Context。

FIG.7.K1 · KNOWLEDGE CONTEXT LIFECYCLE

Source → Organize → Process → Serve → Govern → Agent Context

SOURCE

文档 · 流程 · 规则 · 案例 · 数据

provenance · owner · raw version
ORGANIZE / PROCESS

classify · relate · index · structure

不是所有内容都向量化；保留层级、关系、适用范围和事实结构。
SERVE

RAG · API · Structured Query · File Search

按数据形状、时效、权限和失败语义选择供给方式。
GOVERN

version · permission · validity · correction

owner · expiry · supersede · lineage · usage feedback
CONTEXT

可解释、可验证、可授权的任务上下文

Agent 使用的是经过治理的 evidence，不是无来源文本堆积。
核心原则

Enterprise knowledge is governed context, not merely retrieved text.

FIG.7.1 · MEMORY STRUCTURE

Six-layer Memory Structure

From ephemeral request context to persistent cross-session knowledge, clearly defining lifecycle and governance boundaries.

TIERS
6 LAYERS
GOVERNANCE
CQRS ISOLATED
3x2 High-Density Bento Grid
1. Session Metadata
01 EPHEMERAL
① Session Metadata
conversation_id · user_id · tenant_id · locale · current task · permissions
Scope: single session / request Ephemeral context
2. Working Memory
02 SHORT-TERM
② Working Memory (may expire after the task)
current plan · intermediate results · open questions · tool outputs
May expire when the task ends Execution intermediate state
3. Structured Profile
03 USER PROFILE
③ Structured Profile (stable preferences)
language preference · role · approved tools · report format
Stable preferences · explicitly maintained Static profile
4. Episodic Memory
04 EVENT LOG
④ Episodic Memory (what happened)
user asked X · system did Y · result was Z · feedback ±
What happened · interaction traceability Episodic event stream
5. Semantic Memory
05 KNOWLEDGE
⑤ Semantic Memory (stable facts)
organization / project facts · definitions · policies
Stable facts · knowledge graph Enterprise facts
6. Procedural Memory
06 SKILL / PATTERN
⑥ Procedural Memory (reusable procedures)
how to perform task X · validated workflow · repair strategy
Reusable procedures · solution patterns Procedural skills
Bottom Insight
💡

Architecture layering principle:Short-term memory (①/②) flows through memory/Redis with the session lifecycle; long-term memory (③/④/⑤/⑥) must never be freely written by the model and must pass through Write Pipeline（FIG.7.2） structured extraction, permission checks, deduplication, and version conflict resolution before persistence.

LEDGERAppend-only
Represent normal corrections as new events, while still enforcing deletion, redaction, retention, and derived-cache invalidation.
VIEWSCurrent View
current user profile / current state, derived from the event log.
POLICYGovernance Policy
What can be written, read, expired, or shared. Each Memory record has two times: Valid Time and Transaction Time.
FIG.7.2

Write Pipeline (do not let the model write freely)

STEP 1

Conversation / Event

STEP 2

Candidate Extraction → Normalize → Deduplicate

STEP 3

Conflict Check → Permission / Policy Check

STEP 4

Store（source · confidence · owner · scope · validity · sensitivity · version）→ Update Views

FIG.7.3

Read Pipeline (do not read everything every time)

STEP 1

Current Query

STEP 2

Query Classification → Access Filter

STEP 3

Retrieve Relevant Memory

STEP 4

Rank by Relevance + Recency + Quality → Assemble Context

Multi-user and Permission Isolation

tenant_id · user_id · resource ACL · memory scope. Unauthorized Memory:must not enter retrieval candidates, must not enter model context, and must not have its existence leaked in a refusal.

Honest Positioning of AutodidactAgent

AutodidactAgent mainly implements episodic and procedural memory through solved cases and reusable skills. It is not a general-purpose user-profile memory system.

It is closer to Solved Case + Best Skill + Score + Provenance than to general-purpose long-term user memory.

Short-term → Long-term Memory Promotion

FIG.7.4

Memory Promotion Pipeline

STEP 1

Working State

STEP 2

Candidate Extraction

STEP 3

Importance + Stability

STEP 4

Dedup + Conflict Check

STEP 5

Long-term Store + Provenance

Short-term memory should not automatically “become” long-term memory. Promote only information that is stable, reusable, user-authorized, and low-conflict; temporary tool outputs, unverified inferences, and sensitive information should not be promoted by default.

Context Compression Triggers

Token budget approaching threshold
Topic / task phase changes
Stable decision reached
Repeated transcript with low new information
Tool result is large but only a small evidence subset is needed
Long-running session checkpoint

A reliable approach is not endless “summary of summaries,” but retaining the event log and key provenance and regenerating a compact view from verifiable raw records.

Must Remember

I do not treat the transcript as the state. I maintain structured state and compress views while preserving provenance.

======================= CH8 =======================
2026-09-28 · Verification boundaries

The six memory layers are a handbook taxonomy. Identity and permissions come from trusted security context; memory does not grant authority. Append-only does not mean retaining sensitive content forever; correction, deletion, retention, and view invalidation need explicit policies.

LangGraph memory

Version note: Letta V1 SDK uses memory blocks and archival memory; the current Agent SDK uses Git-backed MemFS, with edits persisted through commit and push. Letta Agent SDK memory

Cross-session Memory: persist governed state, not raw utterances §7.X

Whether “budget must not exceed 5000” should survive across sessions depends first on scope and durability: it may be a current-task constraint, a durable project constraint, or a stable user preference. Memory architecture is about promotion, scope, provenance, conflict, and retrieval policy—not merely storage.

FIG.7.X1 · CROSS-SESSION MEMORY GOVERNANCE

Promote on write, route on read, preserve lineage on conflict

A long-history summary is only a Context View. Durable constraints need structured scope, provenance, validity, and supersession.

WRITE 01

Candidate Extraction

Extract candidate memories from explicit user statements, tool observations, or model inferences, and label source_kind first.
WRITE 02

Scope + Durability Gate

Resolve task, thread, project, user, or tenant scope plus temporary, stable, or expiring durability. Only truly durable information enters long-term storage.
STORE

Durable Memory + Provenance

Persist not only the value but also source, confidence, valid_from / valid_to, supersedes, sensitivity, and owner.
READ

Memory Route + Filters

The current decision determines which memory class is needed, followed by scope, permission, validity, and relevance filtering—not one global vector search over all history.
CONFLICT

Authority + Supersession

Explicit correction, scope specificity, source authority, valid time, and confidence determine the active value together; newer does not automatically mean more authoritative.
Core rule

Write selectively. Read selectively. Expire explicitly. Correct with lineage.

FIG.7.X2 · SAME SENTENCE, DIFFERENT MEMORY LIFETIME

The same “budget ≤5000” statement can belong to three different lifetimes

StatementScopeMemory targetWhen it expires
“This purchase must stay under 5000.”current_taskWorking StateTask completion
“Atlas has a quarterly budget cap of 5000.”project:atlasProject-scoped durable constraintvalid_to / explicit correction
“For future trips, keep each budget under 5000.”userStructured ProfileUser changes the preference
LONG CONTEXT ≠ DURABLE MEMORY

Lost in the Middle shows position sensitivity in long contexts, but cross-session continuity requires persisted state and a memory lifecycle. If information was never persisted, a new thread has nothing to recall.

Enterprise Knowledge Context: enterprise knowledge is governed context §7.K

Enterprise knowledge infrastructure is not about pushing more text into a vector store. It turns organizational concepts, rules, workflows, cases, and live facts into versioned, authorized, traceable agent context.

FIG.7.K1 · KNOWLEDGE CONTEXT LIFECYCLE

Source → Organize → Process → Serve → Govern → Agent Context

SOURCE

Documents · workflows · rules · cases · data

provenance · owner · raw version
ORGANIZE / PROCESS

classify · relate · index · structure

Do not vectorize everything. Preserve hierarchy, relationships, scope, and structured facts.
SERVE

RAG · API · Structured Query · File Search

Choose the serving path by data shape, freshness, permission, and failure semantics.
GOVERN

version · permission · validity · correction

owner · expiry · supersede · lineage · usage feedback
CONTEXT

Explainable, verifiable, authorized task context

The agent consumes governed evidence, not an untraceable pile of text.
Core rule

Enterprise knowledge is governed context, not merely retrieved text.
